1995.simple: The American network rents a line, always on, into the building where the web server lives. It carries one and a half million bits a second.
1995.technical: A leased T1 (DS1): 24 timeslots of 64 kbit/s and one framing bit, 193 bits 8,000 times a second, 1.544 Mbit/s on two copper pairs (B8ZS), with Cisco HDLC on top. A typical 1990s university or company line; in Europe it would be an E1.
